caption: The drawing depicts a single, vertically oriented lantern with a cylindrical body and a conical top. The lantern is shown in grayscale on a plain, light background. The surface of the lantern is covered with intricate, geometric perforations and patterns, consisting of rows of small holes, diagonal and horizontal lines, and repeated triangular shapes. The front of the lantern features a rectangular door that is slightly open, with a latch or handle visible on its left side. At the peak of the conical top, there is a double-looped ring attached, likely for hanging the lantern. Shadows and shading suggest the lantern is metallic, giving it a slightly textured appearance. The drawing includes a signature in cursive at the bottom left, reading “Filippo Careca.”
title: Lantern
